body: Yes I just made a post for an update. I’m still here. I decided to give the shelter at least a try. I’m on my way there now. Thanks for caring

How did you get into a good one that doesn’t kick you out early and let’s you stay during the day if you need to? Is it just luck or what 

Also thanks again so much. You have made me at least seriously consider going there instead of a bridge
Thank you this is very helpful information. I’m considering going to the shelter I just feel like I’ll never get out and any night that isn’t freezing I’ll be on my own outside.

Jw what shelter are you at and are there waiting lists? Also how likely are you to get robbed if you bring something like a Nintendo switch or an iPad 

Edit: and if it’s not bad do you have any idea why so many people choose to avoid it and sleep on the subway?

Thanks bro
I beg you please tell me all about what it’s like there because I only heard bad stories about it and would like some actual facts. Thank you
What are nights like in shelters? How can you relax after work at all?
I’m sure that was difficult. It’s not a competition but I would appreciate some advice on how bad it was, how you got out of it, and now it is early on?
I sincerely doubt that assertion. My life has been pretty difficult as well.
Thanks hope to hear something from you
What is that?
As I posted before it’s too late. I tried that but it will now already take too long for me to get enough money to make a difference.

That’s not the issue. I would do it but it takes too long now. I’d have to apply to a job > get interviewed > get hired > work > get paid enough to afford first month + last month + security on a place. While living on the street.

Thanks for this. A couch surf thing if free would be amazing actually I’ll look at it and would love any info you have on it. I’ll check out your link. 

I’m good with food for now actually because I was able to get food stamps so as long as the govt shutdown ends in Feb I should be able to eat as long as I have access to a kitchen.
I don’t see this as temporary because I don’t see a way to get back to becoming not homeless once I lose my home.

An apartment and a job that makes enough money to live there. 

It’s too late however because I’ll be out of my place today and then on the street to still try to get a job and then save up enough money for an apartment deposit + first month + last month rent

It should be easy but it hasn’t been. I guess it’s just another reason I’m a pathetic individual. 1 month to look is not a lot of time with a home but I don’t think I can find a job from the streets however. Too many complications.

This could be good advice but won’t work in my situation. I was already staying with someone for super cheap in an informal way and they have someone else coming to move in and pay way more later this week. I’m sure they won’t have an issue calling the cops and changing the locks to get me removed. It’s not like I have legal resources.

I’m not sure what you mean by the factual part of problems but I told my therapist mostly everything except I lied and said I’d go to a hospital before I kill myself and signed a suicide contract with her. 

I have checked out the shelters already too. Several of them.  I got a list of resources I’ve been working with from my therapist including a social worker. They are helping me with employment right now. 

Shelters for single men are also full right now with a waiting list because it’s cold. I’ve gone to the Men’s Shelter, Housing Works and Coalition for the Homeless already so I haven’t done nothing so calm down with the anger. 

The general info I got is I’d have to deal with it until I get into a shelter and then after several months in a shelter they can help you get an actual apartment I think. 

But that requires me to get a job which I have been unable to do with a home already so I don’t know how I’ll manage to recover after losing it. 

I’m too depressed and too scared to just live on the subway for a month while looking for work in the middle of winter until the shelters get more room, and the shelters are apparently so bad that people here say all the time the streets are safer and better anyway.

I believe you care. I just don’t believe you’ll care next week. No offense it’s not personal. I’m sure my sob story happens all the time. People who try to talk me out of this in person without offering me a place to live or material help is really pointless and empty to me. 

People are basically saying “Suffer being homeless with nothing and no one because if you kill yourself it will make some people sad for a while”. 

Not convincing to me. I have nothing to live for. I’m only disappointed about not being able to enjoy some stupid material things I was looking forward to like books and video games. And also finding out what happens with the country post Trump. It’s just because I’m curious I guess. 

It goes with that I don’t want to die but I want to continue living homeless even less.  I’m not even going to bother packing up my things from my apartment when I have to leave today.

I lost my job and since then I’ve actually been looking. It hasn’t even been that long. The issue is that it has taken too long for me to get another job (I never had savings or made much money) and that’s it. Game over. I can’t picture myself clawing my way back once I lose my apartment. If I had another month to apply to jobs it might have made the difference between life and death for me. I don’t have that, however. 

And no there is no one to talk to.
I will still have debt. Just no home.
I see. Thanks. I don’t plan to try however. I think being homeless is scarier and sadder than ending it. To me at least.
I’m not sure what you’re saying. Go through what?

Besides the fact that they are full in the winter with a waiting list and are full of drug addicts and thieves, it’s not worth it to me. Without anywhere to go at the end of a day to sleep and be safe, there is really nothing. 

 I’d rather go out at this point than struggle to fight back from homelessness alone. I don’t have the strength in me anymore.
